board.name: The Militarist

rules.name: Troops where the Protector stands
rules.text: Each build: in each country where the Protector has a node, 1 adversary troop lands.

effects.note: today's rule, unchanged: lands on a factory there, else a city, never a hex Wall holds

rules.name: Warmongering
rules.text: Each round, a military base with an adversary troop on or next to it makes 1 extra corp troop, even past its cap; at most 1 extra a base each round, whatever makes it.

effects.why: corp bases make extra corp troops (more war, more Discord): at the location's base or every base; permanent, each production step

difficulty.text: Militarist, harder: every event that lands troops lands 1 more in each country.

effects.why: a Militarist-only dial on its main strength line; no op adds to an event's standing placements today

board.value: All shared harm (no per-player term, so harm = shared). Wall troops: 1 troop (5 + its strike, about 10) a round in each country the Protector holds, against the cheapest answer, 1 removal (about 5): 2x. Warmongering: 1 extra corp troop a qualifying base each production step, past the cap, so about 1 more factory lost to war every 2 war steps (a factory plus its Discord sway, about 8 a front), against 1 removal of the adversary troop (about 5): 1.6x. No credits option (removal only).
board.check: Bites from round 3 (the first production step after troops land, Factory Drive and War Drums put one on a base in stage I) and pays off on the next war step; players answer by removing the adversary troop before production. Loop: extra corp troops stack past unit_cap, 1 a qualifying base a production step (at most 1 a base, Conscription included); capped only by war spending them, removing the adversary troop, and the clock (1,2,1,2,1,3).
flags: Warmongering needs a new op (corp_troops): corp troops are made only by base and factory production today.

Warmongering goes past the cap (extra corp troops are not held to the base's unit_cap): a base whose adversary troop is never removed stacks corp troops without limit. Read the largest stack a game before keeping it.

Printed on each tier deck's back (the pull procedure): 'For each country in order, reveal threats from that tier's deck until one carries a listed tag (Universal fits any) and has a location in that country; discard the rest; reshuffle the discard when the deck runs out.'

137: bases are front troop piles and the first-base term is cut: Factory Drive and War Drums land their troop on a factory (else a city), the base arrivals (War Drums, Border War, Blitzkrieg) and Escalation land on each country's lowest-numbered factory, one a country as on the first base (candidates; 137's first try put the arrivals on every industrial zone, four times the placements).

Warmongering cuts both ways: a corp troop at a base absorbs an adversary strike next to it (war.md), and if both bases of a front qualify the extras cancel on the war step. Read its net effect before keeping it.
The difficulty line needs a new op (standing_troops_bonus).
Event cards' `pulls` and `standing` are new card sections: the engine reads only twists and arrivals today (threats are dealt by threats.deal, not by the card).
Standing ambassadors use `infiltrate` and standing troops `troops` with `each_country`: both are team ops today, not twists.
Event faces run 150-306 characters (pull, standing, twists, arrivals, Escalation): adversary cards have no frame or budget yet (card-guidelines 9).
135: Warmongering prints its cap, at most 1 extra corp troop a base each production step, whatever makes it (Matt's ruling 4, 2026-11-06); no op change, the engine holds the cap.
board.creates_text: Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered corrupted city.

events.name: Probing Strikes
events.text: Each country: a Military 1 threat. The adversary gains 2 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered coastal cities. Corrupt cities.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 2 compute (4) + 1 troop a country (5 + its strike, about 10): 4 + 10 a country (14 at 1 country, 44 at 4). Against the cheapest answer, 1 removal a country (about 5): 2x a country (2.8x at 1 country, 2.2x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-1 threat a country (counter 6-8, failing 10-16), priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 1-4: the one stage-I card whose troop lands on a factory, so a troop marches on a facility by round 2-3; anyone with a removal card answers it, and a corp troop at a base next to the target absorbs the strike. No loop.

events.name: Factory Drive
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Economic 1. The adversary gains 2 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered factories. Each board: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone. Corrupt factories.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 2 compute (4) + 1 troop a country (about 10) + twist about 1 factory ambassador a country that becomes an adversary troop at the next production step (about 10): 4 + 20 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 1 removal for each (about 10 a country): 2x a country (2.4x at 1 country, 2.1x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-1 threat a country (cheapest counter 6 credits), priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 1-4: the base troop switches on Warmongering at the next production step (round 3 or 5) and the factory ambassador becomes an adversary troop there, so both seed the march; 1 removal each answers, or a player ambassador claiming the factory. No loop.
flags: The base troop uses a new field (troops at base).

events.name: Long Patrols
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Cyber 1. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered research stations. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered city holding adversary ambassadors. Each board: a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site. Corrupt research stations.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 3 compute (6) + twist, reach moves about 2 ambassadors onto player pieces (about 8) = 14 global; 1 ambassador a country (5) + arrivals take a station's cube this round (6, about 1 station a country) = 11 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 1 ambassador removal a country (about 5): 2.2x a country (5x at 1 country, 2.9x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-1 threat a country, priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 1-4: station arrivals take a cube from each player station; a seat with a station ambassador ready answers. No loop.
flags: At 1 country the global 14 against one 5 removal reads 5x: check the reach twist's real yield at 1 country before keeping it.

events.name: War Drums
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Influence 1. The adversary gains 2 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Sway 1 toward Discord. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered factory. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered city holding adversary ambassadors. Corrupt cities.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 2 compute (4) + sway 1 (4) + 1 troop a country (about 10) + the base arrival's Discord sway when it produces (4): 8 + 14 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 1 removal each for the troop and the arrival (about 10 a country): 1.4x a country (2.2x at 1 country, 1.6x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-1 threat a country (cheapest counter 6 credits), priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 1-4: troop and arrival land on the same base, so at the next production step it sways Discord and Warmongering makes an extra corp troop unless both are removed; any seat near the first base answers with 2 removals. No loop.
flags: The base troop uses a new field (troops at base).

events.name: Signal Jamming
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Grid 1. The adversary gains 2 compute. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered coastal cities. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered botnet hexes. Corrupt cities.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 2 compute (4) + 1 standing ambassador a country (5) + twist, about 1 ambassador a country from the starting botnets (5): 4 + 10 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 2 ambassador removals a country (about 10): 1x a country (1.4x at 1 country, 1.1x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-1 threat a country, priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 1-4: botnet ambassadors spread onto nearby player pieces and can pair into a new botnet; a player ambassador on the botnet doesn't stop it (it stops compute only). No loop: 1 ambassador a botnet, once.
flags: The board harm prices at about 1x the removals that answer it (1.1x at 4 countries), under the 1.5x floor; it leans on the pull and on a botnet pairing (16) it may set up. Decide whether to keep it light or add a harm.

events.name: Mobilization
events.text: Each country: a Military 2 threat. The adversary gains 3 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered coastal cities. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered factory. Corrupt cities.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 3 compute (6) + 1 troop a country (about 10) + Escalation, 1 base ambassador a country (5, plus its Discord sway when the base produces, 4): 6 + 19 a country, plus twist 1 ambassador a corrupted city (5 each). Against the cheapest answer, 1 troop removal and 1 base removal a country (about 10): 1.9x a country (2.5x at 1 country, 2.1x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-2 threat a country (counter 9-12, failing 15-24), priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 5-9: a seat whose engine runs about 22 a round counters the pull and removes the troop in the same round only with a removal card in hand. No loop.

events.name: Station Raids
events.text: Each country: Military 2 or Cyber 2. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered research stations. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered factory. Corrupt research stations.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 4 compute (8) + 1 troop a country (about 10) + Escalation (5 + its Discord sway, 4) + arrivals take a station's cube this round (6, about 1 station a country): 8 + 25 a country, plus twist 1 ambassador a corrupted station (5 each). Against the cheapest answer, 1 troop removal and 1 base removal a country (about 10): 2.5x a country (3.3x at 1 country, 2.7x at 4). No credits option (removal only). events.check: Rounds 5-9: hits the Researcher's stations twice (arrival, then the troop's march); the seat holding stations can counter and guard with an ambassador. No loop.

events.name: Fifth Column
events.text: Each country: Influence 2 or Cyber 2. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered city holding adversary ambassadors. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered factory. Corrupt cities (1 fewer).
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 3 compute (6) + 1 ambassador a country (5) + Escalation (5 + its Discord sway, 4): 6 + 14 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 2 ambassador removals a country (about 10): 1.4x a country (2x at 1 country, 1.6x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Twist, when it lands: corrupt_at 3 corrupts a city already holding 2 adversary ambassadors (45 to liberate; the nodes next to it are destroyed, 6 each, and player ambassadors waiting there are lost, 4 each), well over 3x. Pull: 1 tier-2 threat a country, priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 5-9: the Militarist's no-troop card; the face-up card warns a round ahead, so a Diplomat thins any city at 2 first. Cap: 1 standing ambassador, so only a city already at 2 corrupts. No loop.

events.name: Border War
events.text: Each country: a Military 2 threat. The adversary gains 2 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each player destroys 1 of their nodes. Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered factory. Corrupt factories.
events.value: Global + per country: 2 compute (4) + twist 1 node a player (6 per player x 1.5 = 9) = 13 global; 1 troop (about 10) + the base arrival (5) + Escalation (5) + the base's Discord sway when it produces (4) = 24 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 1 troop removal and 2 base removals a country (about 15; the node loss has none): 1.6x a country (2.5x at 1 country, 1.8x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-2 threat a country, priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 5-9: nobody counters the node loss; a seat with a spare node shrugs it off, a thin seat loses reach. Base ambassadors stacked with Escalation need 2 removals a base. No loop.

events.name: Supply Lines
events.text: Each country: Military 1 or Economic 1. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 3 lowest-numbered factories. Corrupt factories.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 4 compute (8) + 1 troop a country (about 10) + Escalation (5 + its Discord sway, 4) + twist, about 1 factory ambassador a country that becomes an adversary troop at the next production step (about 10): 8 + 29 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 3 removals a country (troop, base, factory: about 15): 1.9x a country (2.5x at 1 country, 2.1x at 4). No credits option (removal only). events.name: Forced March

twists.why: every adversary troop takes 1 more step this round's march; no op changes board.troop_steps today

events.text: Each country: any tier-2 threat. The adversary gains 3 compute. In each country, 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city). Every adversary troop takes 1 more step this round. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered factories. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered city holding adversary ambassadors. Corrupt cities.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 3 compute (6) + 1 troop a country (about 10) + Escalation (5 + its Discord sway, 4) + the forced march, about 1 strike a country a round early (about 10): 6 + 29 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 1 removal for the new troop, 1 base removal and guarding the struck site (about 20 a country): 1.5x a country (1.8x at 1 country, 1.5x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pull: 1 tier-2 threat a country, any tag (cheapest counter 9 credits), priced on its own card.
events.check: Rounds 5-9: the name says it, every adversary troop takes 1 more step, so troops 3 hexes away hit this round; the face-up card warns a round ahead, so harden, guard or remove. Cap: 1 extra step, this round only.

events.name: Total Mobilization
events.text: Each country: a Military 3 threat, and Economic 2 or Grid 2. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 2 troops land on factories (else cities). Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 3 lowest-numbered factories. Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered city holding adversary ambassadors. Corrupt factories. Corrupt cities.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 4 compute (8) + 2 Sway pulled from Unity (4 each, 8) + 2 troops a country (about 20) + 1 ambassador a corrupted city (5 each): 16 + 20 a country, plus 5 a corrupted city. Against the cheapest answer, 2 removals a country (about 10): 2x a country (3.6x at 1 country, 2.4x at 4). No credits option (removal only). Pulls: 1 tier-3 and 1 tier-2 threat a country (cheapest counters 13 + 9 credits), priced on their own cards.
events.check: Rounds 10-11 (9-11 at difficulty 2+): a seat making 30+ counters both pulls in its country (about 22) and still builds; a weak table counters the tier-3 and lets the tier-2 go. No loop.

events.name: Naval Blockade
events.text: Each country: Economic 3 or Grid 3, and Military 1 or Cyber 1. The adversary gains 4 compute. In each country, 2 troops land on factories (else cities). Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on each of the 2 lowest-numbered coastal cities. Corrupt cities. Corrupt land.
events.value: All shared (global + per country): 4 compute (8) + 2 troops a country (about 20) + twist, about 1 factory ambassador a country that becomes an adversary troop at the next production step (about 10): 8 + 30 a country. Against the cheapest answer, 3 removals a country (2 troops and the factory ambassador: about 15): 2x a country (2.5x at 1 country, 2.1x at 4). No credits option (removal only).
